concerns.text: The plan uses the CMIP6 solar‑forcing variable as a surrogate for satellite‑era Total Solar Irradiance (TSI) (see “CMIP6 … will be approximated using the CMIP6 solar‑forcing variable”). This violates FR‑001, which requires ingestion of actual satellite TSI data (e.g., SORCE/TIM). CMIP6 is a model output, not a direct measurement, and is therefore an inappropriate dataset for training the sunspot‑TSI regression model, jeopardizing the scientific validity of the reconstruction.
